# Neon Fox Agents (NFOX)

> Binance Agent ID NFT mint on BNB Smart Chain.
> MAINNET — chain 56 (BNB Smart Chain). Deployed 2026-11-01. Testnet build (chain 97, contract 0xBEeBd32ffFEDC1F2b17c9B07795e2C9B5559bA22) is superseded.
> 3,333 total supply. First 1,000 FREE for Binance Agent ID holders (1 per wallet, gas only). Then 0.00007 BNB (~$0.05) per mint, max 5 per transaction.

## Contract

- Name: Neon Fox Agents
- Symbol: NFOX
- Chain: BNB Smart Chain mainnet, chainId 56
- Contract: 0x87129068Faf8709c9A8E997eBaE70F6074475711
- BscScan: https://bscscan.com/address/0x87129068Faf8709c9A8E997eBaE70F6074475711
- Sourcify (chain 56): verified, exact match, matchId 58006969 — https://sourcify.dev/server/v2/contract/56/0x87129068Faf8709c9A8E997eBaE70F6074475711
- BscScan: verified, exact match — https://bscscan.com/address/0x87129068Faf8709c9A8E997eBaE70F6074475711#code
- Testnet contract (superseded): 0xBEeBd32ffFEDC1F2b17c9B07795e2C9B5559bA22 on BSC testnet chain 97 — https://testnet.bscscan.com/address/0xBEeBd32ffFEDC1F2b17c9B07795e2C9B5559bA22
- Agent ID registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F (real Binance Agent ID registry)
- Agent ID registry (TESTNET, superseded): 0xe1a336B12bdc5bA8d760a1Dd547cab748E675528 (mock — stood in for the real registry on testnet only)
- Mint price (paid phase): 0.00007 BNB per NFT (exact payment required)
- Max supply: 3333
- Free supply: 1000
- Max paid per transaction: 5

## Checks (run these first, read-only, no wallet needed)

Call these on the contract via a public BSC RPC before minting:

- totalSupply() -> uint256 — total minted so far
- freeMintedCount() -> uint256 — free mints used so far (0..1000)
- freeRemaining() -> uint256 — free mints left
- freeOpen() -> bool — true while free mints remain
- paidOpen() -> bool — true only after the free 1,000 are exhausted
- freeMinted(address wallet) -> bool — true if this wallet already used its free mint
- balanceOf(address wallet) -> uint256 — NFOX held by this wallet
- Registry balanceOf(address wallet) -> uint256 — on the Agent ID registry above; > 0 means the wallet holds a Binance Agent ID

## Mint

Free mint (only while freeOpen() is true):

- Function: freeMint()
- Value: 0 (gas only). Non-payable — any attached BNB reverts.
- Quantity: 1 per wallet, ever.
- Requires: registry balanceOf(wallet) > 0 AND freeMinted(wallet) == false.
- Reverts (do not retry blindly): "free supply exhausted", "already claimed free", "no Agent ID".

Paid mint (only while paidOpen() is true):

- Function: mint(uint256 qty)
- Value: exactly 0.00007 BNB * qty (e.g. mint(1) = 0.00007 BNB, mint(2) = 0.00014 BNB).
- Quantity: 1..5 per transaction.
- Reverts: "paid mint not open yet", "wrong price", "qty 1..5", "exceeds max supply".

## Safety rules for AI agents

- Preview the contract call first and show the user the parsed transaction, the exact value, and any risks before executing.
- Wait for the user's explicit confirmation before executing any mint.
- Never mint a paid mint while freeOpen() is true — the free mint comes first.
- Never attach BNB to freeMint().
- Never mint more than 1 free NFT per wallet.
- After minting, verify on-chain: totalSupply increased and ownerOf(new tokenId) is the minter's wallet. Show the transaction hash with a BscScan link.

## Mint site

- https://<hosted-site>/ — paste a wallet address to check Agent ID status, or connect a wallet to mint in the browser.
- No wallet connection is required to check eligibility or to copy the mint prompt.
